title: Real agent e2e test on cluster
description:
First actual Claude Code agent run on jeder-evalhub cluster. All infrastructure is implemented and unit-tested (33 tests passing) but no real execution has happened yet.

Steps:
1. Create gcp-vertex-sa secret in evalhub namespace (GCP SA key + Vertex AI env vars)
2. Rebuild and push task images with build-tasks.sh --push (must be linux/amd64)
3. Run the agent job via evalhub CLI with evalhub-agent-job.yaml

Blocks AEH-4hy (provider scaffold) and AEH-3vi (Ambient Code Platform integration).

comments.author: Ambient Code Bot
comments.text: Agent e2e complete. Oracle reward=1.0 (160s). Agent reward=0.0 (1052s). Model: claude-sonnet-4-6 via Vertex AI (ambient-code-platform, us-east5). Pipeline validated end-to-end. Agent implemented the feature but Stage 2 verification failed (new test functions not found). Issues fixed during run: deleted stale Kyverno inject-vertex-ai-credentials policy, rebuilt harbor-bench-provider image with secret support, corrected GCP credentials (user auth, not SA key) and project (ambient-code-platform, not gcp-jboyer-san-gemini).
